scope: Upstream test cases ported to Python. Each case names its upstream spec file and title; python_tests lists the Python tests carrying the matching upstream mark.

cases.source: packages/core/scope/tests/scope.spec.ts::createScope > exposes the exact raw disposer for ordered composite teardown
packages/core/scope/tests/scope.spec.ts::createScope > is usable synchronously before the backing fiber activates
packages/core/scope/tests/scope.spec.ts::createScope > shares quiescence across repeat and raw-disposer-first calls
packages/core/scope/tests/scope.spec.ts::createScope > tags contexts and derived contexts, with the nearest tag winning
packages/core/scope/tests/scope.spec.ts::scope parent chain > admits an ancestor-tagged listener for a descendant dispatch, never the reverse

cases.notes: Async test: deepseek-cordis mounts plugins only inside a running event loop.

cases.source: packages/core/scope/tests/store.spec.ts::AnonymousEntries > owns equal values independently with live insertion-ordered iteration and idempotent undo
packages/core/scope/tests/store.spec.ts::AnonymousEntries > starts a fresh iterator generation after the table drains
packages/core/scope/tests/store.spec.ts::NamedEntries > owns duplicate diagnostics, lookup, insertion order, live iteration, and exact idempotent undo
packages/core/scope/tests/store.spec.ts::NamedEntries > starts a fresh iterator generation after the table drains
packages/core/scope/tests/store.spec.ts::ScopedLayers > cleans up failed factories and empty failed actions without discarding an existing layer

cases.notes: The fake context exposes metadata because scope_of reads ctx.metadata; the effect call is checked by recorded arguments instead of a vitest mock.
